Looking for a porta cabin in Visakhapatnam? SAMAN manufactures steel porta cabins and ships them ready-to-use to sites across Visakhapatnam from our Bangalore factory. The road distance is about 1,000 km, so a finished unit usually reaches your site in 4 to 6 days. You get a single-room steel cabin â€” site office, security post, rest room, or store â€” built to size, wired, and finished before it leaves the factory. It arrives ready to use, with no on-site construction.

SAMAN has been making prefab steel structures since 2009 and runs two factories â€” Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Vizag is served fully from Bangalore, and as a direct porta cabin manufacturer we control the steel, the panels, and the finish in-house â€” so what we quote is what we build.

Why buyers in Visakhapatnam choose SAMAN

Visakhapatnam is a port, steel, and heavy-industry city. Vizag Port and Gangavaram Port, the RINL Vizag Steel Plant, the petroleum and chemical units near the coast, the pharma corridor, and the IT growth around Rushikonda â€” all of it runs on sites that need movable, weather-tight workspace. A porta cabin gives you that without tying up land or pouring a permanent slab for a temporary need.

The coastal location matters for the build. Salt air corrodes ordinary steel fast, so our frames are anti-rust treated and the panels are sealed against humidity. We build to order, sized for your site, finished in your colour, and fitted with the points and windows you need. SAMAN holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification, with 500+ projects delivered across India.

Local industries in Visakhapatnam that use porta cabins

Vizag's demand is heavy-industry and port-driven:

  • Visakhapatnam Port and Gangavaram Port (530035) â€” freight, logistics, and stevedoring operators use porta cabins as gate offices, weighbridge cabins, and supervisor rooms.
  • RINL / Vizag Steel Plant belt (530031) â€” steel and engineering contractors use them as on-site project offices and shift-supervisor cabins.
  • Jawaharlal Nehru Pharma City, Parawada (531019) â€” pharma and chemical units use them as QC rooms, security posts, and staff rest areas.
  • Atchutapuram and the APSEZ industrial belt â€” manufacturing units use them as movable site offices that relocate with the work.

For any site from the port to Parawada, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day.

Specifications and sizes

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The standard build:

  • Frame: mild steel hollow section, welded and anti-rust treated â€” important in Vizag's salt-air coastal climate
  • Wall panels: PUF insulated sandwich panel or cement fibre board
  • Roof: GI sheet or colour-coated profile sheet with slope for rain and cyclone-season runoff
  • Flooring: marine ply, cement board, or vinyl over a steel base
  • Doors and windows: powder-coated steel or aluminium, sealed against humidity

Sizes run from a compact 6Ã—8 ft security cabin up to 20Ã—8 ft and 40Ã—8 ft office units, with multi-room layouts available. For full construction detail and finish options, see the MS-frame porta cabin product page â€” the build most Vizag site offices use. Any size in between is made to order.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it:

  • Split AC points and extra power sockets for office use
  • Internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting room
  • Toilet and washbasin block built into the unit
  • Glass front for a reception, gate, or weighbridge cabin
  • Loft storage above the ceiling line
  • Sealed, anti-skid flooring for humid coastal sites

Price guidance

A porta cabin price in Visakhapatnam depends on the size, the wall panel you choose (cement board is economical, PUF panel costs more but insulates better), the interior fit-out, and the transport distance â€” Vizag is one of our longer South routes, so freight is a real factor in the quote. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm a firm price at quotation once we know your size and use â€” no hidden add-ons after.

Delivery and installation to Visakhapatnam

Your cabin is built and finished at our Bangalore factory, then trucked to Visakhapatnam â€” typically 4 to 6 days from dispatch given the distance. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base â€” a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground â€” ready before delivery.

We deliver across the Andhra coast and the wider South from the same factory. If you are comparing options for a nearby site, you can also see our porta cabin in Vijayawada and porta cabin in Hyderabad pages.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a porta cabin cost in Visakhapatnam?

The price depends on size, panel type, fit-out, and transport. Because Vizag is a longer route from our Bangalore factory, freight is part of the quote. We confirm the exact figure once we know your requirement.

How long does delivery to Visakhapatnam take?

Usually 4 to 6 days from dispatch out of our Bangalore factory, since the road distance is about 1,000 km.

Are the cabins suitable for Vizag's coastal, salty air?

Yes. The frames are anti-rust treated and the panels and joinery are sealed against humidity and salt air, which matters on the Vizag coast.

Can the porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. It is a bolted steel structure â€” it can be lifted, loaded, and relocated when your site work moves.

What sizes are available?

From a 6Ã—8 ft single cabin up to 40Ã—8 ft office units and larger multi-room layouts, all made to order.

Get a quote for your porta cabin in Visakhapatnam

Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will send a clear quote. For Bangalore and South India, call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or send an enquiry through the form and our team will get back to you.
